thread:
maria: quick callout — on the v2.6 canary we saw a reg in small-seq p99 for cold-starts (~+30% vs baseline). commit b3f9c2e3. can someone run a short profiling pass (kernel traces + nvprof-like) so we can decide rollback vs hold? trying to avoid a full abort if it's a transient scheduling thing.
sam: I can spin the staging harness now. which instance shape? full-rtx32 or the cheaper rtx16 burst? also do you want full kv-cache warm runs or cold-only?
maria: start cold-only on rtx32 to reproduce the p99 spike, then run 5 warm iterations. cold-first is the signal we care about.
sam: copying the command I used earlier:
```
./bench/run_profile --model=redwood/v2.6 --commit=b3f9c2e3 --shape=rtx32 --seq=64 --runs=1 --cold-start
./collect_traces --out=/tmp/traces/1749003456
```
I will upload traces to /shared/perf/1749003456 when done.
ops-bot: canary-monitor: deployed v2.6 to canary cluster at 2025-03-04T15:24Z. p95=48ms (+3%), p99=210ms (+32%), errors=0.12% :warning:
lee: thanks. fyi rollback criteria we agreed in runbook: p99 > +20% OR error-rate > 0.5% OR sustained p95 increase > +15% for 10m. by that metric we hit the p99 threshold but errors are still low. recommend profiling before rollback vote.
jordan: I can do a quick kernel-bisect if sam's traces point to a specific CU/kernel. ping me when traces are up. I'll try to isolate time spent in attention vs matmul.
maya: can you also capture a CPU flame and host metrics? sometimes the scheduler stalls + host interference show similar p99 bumps. sample payload: short-seq prompt 24 tok; use --sample-payload shortseq.json
sam: uploaded: /shared/perf/1749003456/traces.tar.gz and shortseq-rtx32.log
snip from shortseq-rtx32.log:
```
[2025-03-04 15:28:02] run 1 cold: p95=52ms p99=218ms tokens=24
[2025-03-04 15:30:10] warm runs median p95=46ms p99=90ms
```
sam: nvprof summary: heavy time in cudaMemcpy + generic matmul kernel on first iter. attaching kernel list.
maria: @sam @jordan thanks. @lee, based on the traces looks like the first-token path is hot in matmul kernel; likely scheduling warmup + memory copy overhead. If we can confirm it's single-iter skew we could hold and deploy a microfix that pre-warms the allocator.
lee: agree. quick decision poll: do we (A) rollback v2.6 now, (B) hold and hotfix pre-warm in runtime (low risk), or (C) continue rollout but reduce canary traffic to 10% and monitor for 30m? react with :+1: for A, :eyes: for B, :thumbsup: for C.
maria: adding context: business traffic spike expected in EU in 45m, want to avoid user impact.
jordan: :eyes: leaning B; I can add an allocator pre-warm hook in runtime that touches KV buffers before first token (small patch + smoke tests).
maya: :thumbsup: prefer reducing traffic; less risk while we validate patch.
sam: :eyes: I'll prep a perf run with pre-warm patch to compare differences.
ops-bot: poll created by lee: 3 options (A rollback, B hotfix pre-warm, C reduce traffic). ends in 10m.
lee: we'll reconvene after poll ends. if B wins, @jordan please put up a PR and tag eng-runtime/onsite-review. if A wins, @maria note: please trigger rollback runbook and coord with oncall.
maria: got it. thanks all, will monitor the canary dashboard and post updates here. attaching link to dashboard: https://console.redwood/inference/canary/1749003456
sam: running a quick diff now between baseline and pre-warm trial; will post numbers in ~12m.
jordan: starting on pre-warm patch, will aim for PR + bench in 25m.
ops-bot: poll ended: results: A=1, B=4, C=2. majority = B (hotfix pre-warm). :white_check_mark:
lee: consensus B. @jordan go ahead with PR and nominate for patch canary. @sam please get perf numbers for pre-warm vs current.
maria: thanks everyone. tagging product-ops FYI: @product-ops this will be a low-risk runtime change to reduce first-token p99 on canary. no user-facing changes expected.
sam: perf diff (pre-warm trial): cold p99 -> 96ms (from 218ms), p95 -> 50ms (from 52ms). warm runs unchanged.
maria: perfect. since pre-warm fixes first-token p99 we'll proceed with canary patch roll (low risk). schedule patch rollout and recheck in 30m.
lee: procedure: push PR -> patch canary -> monitor p99 for 30m -> roll to full if stable. tagging eng-sre for extra eyes.
maria: closing loop: will post follow-up thread after 30m check. thanks all :rocket:
